name: Build Hero
tagline: A website hero where one scroll builds the place from bare ground while the camera moves, then evening falls and the lights come on.
youSay: /build-hero A launch page for a new riverside condo tower, sold before it's built
whatYouGet: A pinned hero film: one scroll plays the place being built, from raw materials to finished, with a real change of camera angle, and one flick plays it all by itself in 3 seconds
An evening finale: dusk falls over the finished place, then the lights switch on in an order that suits it: floor by floor, across a kitchen, outward from a pool, candles first
A scaffold of readouts round the film: crop marks, a counter, a stage ruler and captions timed to the build, which come down when evening falls
The whole page around it with its own look and words, a headless check on desktop and phone, and a video of the build, as a static site you can host anywhere
goodFit: Anything sold before it exists or made by hand: new homes and towers, kitchens, renovations, pools and gardens, shop fit-outs, event styling
Pages where seeing it come together is the reason to buy
notFor: Exact real buildings or real places: the film is generated, so it shows the idea, not your approved plans
Pages that must be very light: the film is about 130 frames (around 15 MB on desktop)
youBring: What gets built and who it's for
Optional: the brand's name, colours and tone, and a reference picture of the finished place
needs: Skillsmart credits: about 550 for a page

generates.estimate: about 550 a page: 20 a picture, 15 a second of film

network.purpose: sharp for the tools; playwright-core for the headless check (installed once)
